// generated by build.ps1 for faction "Warsaw Pact" - edit src\WarMotives.txt, not this file
def set MAP_RIVALS = {"United States", "NATO", "American Allies"}
def set ALL_FACTIONS = {"United States", "Soviet Union", "NATO", "Warsaw Pact", "American Allies", "Soviet Allies", "China", "India", "Pakistan", "Neutral"}
def int EVAL_OFFSET_SEC = 120  // staggers evaluations across factions

// ===========================================================================
//  Less Aggressive AI  -  "War Motives" layer
//  SOURCE FILE - not loaded by the game.  build.ps1 stamps this script into
//  every AI faction event file of the target map (Maps/<map>.virtual/Events/)
//  because files pulled in via USE resolve to the base game, not to mods.
// ===========================================================================
//
//  IDEA
//  The built-in AI only knows "preparing for war" and "at war".  This script
//  adds a reason layer in front of it.  At game start every AI faction is put
//  on a leash (BlockAttack / BlockInvasion against everyone it is not allied
//  with).  Every few minutes it scores each rival SEPARATELY on:
//
//     + Land grab    : the rival's regions on our border are thinly held
//                      compared to our own border forces
//     + Outpaced     : the rival's MILITARY power has grown faster than ours
//                      for several evaluations (preventive-war motive)
//     + Distracted   : the rival is already fighting somebody else
//     + Ally at war  : the rival is fighting one of our permanent allies
//     + Occupier     : the rival holds regions that belong to us or an ally
//     + Old rivalry  : the map's DefaultEnemy list (mild nudge only)
//     + Grievance    : accumulated, decaying provocations that do NOT start a
//                      war by themselves in the engine:
//                        - sustained troop build-up on our shared border
//                        - their aircraft (spy planes, AWACS...) inside our
//                          territory
//     - Stronger     : the rival's total military clearly outweighs ours
//     - Blind        : our INTEL COVERAGE of the rival is poor (see below)
//     - Committed    : we have already picked a fight with someone else
//
//  Direct attacks and invasions are not scored - the engine starts hostilities
//  on those anyway.  Instead they immediately RELEASE the leash so a leashed
//  faction can always fight back.
//
//  INTEL
//  In INTEL_MODE every rival is measured by the units THIS faction can
//  currently see (radar, satellites, spy planes, spies).  "Blind" is about
//  coverage, not about how little we see: it compares the number of their
//  units we can see with the number that exist.  A rival whose whole
//  territory we watch and who really has few troops is NOT blind - it is
//  weak, and gets invaded.  A rival we have no recon on is blind, however
//  strong or weak it really is.
//
//  When one rival's score clears WAR_THRESHOLD the leash is released for THAT
//  faction only (AllowAttack / AllowInvasion).  The engine's own readiness
//  checks, peace timer and the garrison gates from AI/Default/StaticDefence.txt
//  still apply after release - the script decides WHETHER and WHOM, the engine
//  decides WHEN it is ready.  Being strong or scary does NOT protect a rival's
//  weak neighbour: each target is judged on its own numbers.
//
//  All tunables are in points (ints).  100 points = threshold.
// ===========================================================================


// ---------------------------------------------------------------- tunables --

def int EVAL_PERIOD_MIN     = 6      // game minutes between evaluations
def int WARMUP_MIN          = 30     // no SCORED declarations before this many game minutes: units are still
                                     // auto-deploying (~15 min) and the engine's peace timer (default 10 min)
                                     // should be honoured.  Retaliation for being attacked is never delayed.
def int WAR_THRESHOLD       = 100    // score needed to release the leash
def int RANDOM_FUDGE        = 20     // 0..N random points added each eval (no clockwork)

// ---- standoff pressure: a rival that has been an OPPORTUNITY for a long
//      time (score within reach of the threshold, evaluation after
//      evaluation) slowly wears down restraint.  After STANDOFF_EVALS such
//      evaluations there is a small chance per cycle of acting anyway.
def int STANDOFF_MIN_SCORE  = 75     // "within reach" = base score at least this (no roll)
def int STANDOFF_EVALS      = 15     // 15 x 6 min = 90 game-minutes of standoff first
def int STANDOFF_CHANCE_PCT = 5      // then this % per evaluation (~1 in 20)
// On-screen reporting:
//   0 = silent
//   1 = events only (release default): a faction declares war, stands down,
//       or authorises nuclear weapons - each with the reason that caused it
//   2 = + each faction's top-scoring rival every evaluation, and every
//       pairing with DEBUG_WATCH (tuning and diagnosis)
//   3 = + every rival pairing of every faction (very noisy)
def int DEBUG_MESSAGES      = 1
def string DEBUG_WATCH      = "United States" // at level 2, this rival's line is always printed
// How wars are fought.  1 = LimitedAttack: a limited operation against that
// faction only, re-issued every evaluation while at war, invasion stays
// blocked.  2 = AttackFaction: the engine's full war against that faction -
// the only mode in which it plans a ground INVASION.
//
// THE MOTIVE PICKS THE MODE.  Territorial reasons (land grab, occupied land)
// mean we want the ground -> invasion.  Punitive reasons (grievances, being
// out-built) mean we want to hurt or set back -> limited strikes.  Backing an
// ally means joining their war properly -> full.  A limited war escalates to
// invasion later if a territorial motive clears the threshold on its own.
def int MODE_TERRITORIAL    = 2      // landgrab / occupier
def int MODE_ALLY_AT_WAR    = 2      // joining a permanent ally's war
def int MODE_PUNITIVE       = 1      // grievance / outpaced / anything else
def int RETALIATION_MODE    = 1      // hitting back at someone who attacked us
// A war the ENGINE ended (ceasefire, peace treaty, surrender) stays ended:
// the faction is dropped from our war list, re-leashed, and protected from
// any SCORED declaration for this many evaluations.  Retaliation for a real
// attack is never blocked.  Also covers a declaration the engine refused
// (e.g. under a treaty we cannot see): if we are not at war two evaluations
// after ordering one, the order is withdrawn and the same protection applies.
// ---- stalemate: a war that has gone nowhere for a long time is wound down.
//      Neither side has taken ground and we are not making progress, so the
//      faction stops prosecuting it and stands down (and, once the syntax is
//      verified, will offer a ceasefire).
def int STALEMATE_EVALS     = 20     // 20 x 6 min = two game-hours of war...
def int STALEMATE_GAIN_PCT  = 0      // ...with no net region change either way

def int PEACE_COOLDOWN_EVALS = 10    // 10 x 6 min = one game-hour
def int PARTNERS_EXEMPT     = 1      // a partnership (relation 2) is never scored or declared on, like an
                                     // alliance (3).  Relation codes seen in saves: 0 war, 1 neutral, 2 partner, 3 ally.

// ---- nuclear doctrine: nukes are a last resort, released tier by tier and
//      never taken back.  Tier 1 (tactical) when we may fail to hold a region
//      we are actually being invaded in.  Tier 2 (strategic) when the threat
//      is existential.  Either tier also in kind, the moment we are hit by it.
def int NUCLEAR_DOCTRINE    = 1      // 0 = vanilla (AI free to use whatever it has)
def int TACTICAL_HOLD_RATIO_PCT = 100 // invaders in one of our regions >= this % of our divisions there...
def int TACTICAL_REGION_PCT = 5      // ...AND that region is worth >= this % of our starting production
                                     //    (a border backwater does not go nuclear)
def int TACTICAL_REGIONS_LOST = 2    // OR we have already lost this many starting regions outright
// Existential = TERRITORY, not units (divisions are cheap to replace, land
// is not).  Strategic weapons when, while at war, we have lost either this
// many of our starting regions, or any single region that was this large a
// share of our starting economy.
def int EXIST_REGIONS_LOST  = 2      // at least this many starting regions lost...
def int EXIST_REGIONS_PCT   = 20     // ...AND at least this % of them (Neutral owns 93; 3 is not existential)
def int EXIST_HOLD_EVALS    = 3      // ...AND held against us for this many consecutive evaluations.
                                     // REGION_OWNER flips while a region is merely CONTESTED, so a
                                     // snapshot counts battlefields as conquests; a real loss persists.
def int STRATEGIC_REGION_PCT = 25    // one region worth >= this % of our starting production

// factions never leashed nor scored.  Deliberately EMPTY: a faction left out
// of the leash becomes the only legal outlet for the engine's war readiness
// (test 2: NATO, India and Pakistan all jumped on Neutral within 11 minutes).
// Neutral is therefore leashed like everyone else and can only be invaded as
// a scored land grab.
def set IGNORED_FACTIONS    = {""}

// intel
def int INTEL_MODE          = 1      // 1 = count only visible enemy units, 0 = omniscient
def int BLIND_COVERAGE_PCT  = 50     // blind if we see fewer than this % of their ground units
def int BLIND_POINTS        = 40     // subtracted when blind
def int LANDGRAB_MIN_COVERAGE_PCT = 50 // no land-grab assessment at all below this coverage

// land grab: our border divisions vs theirs, in percent
def int LANDGRAB_RATIO_PCT  = 150    // our divisions adjacent to the weak spot >=150% of theirs in it
def int LANDGRAB_MIN_OWN_DIVS = 2    // ...and at least this many of ours available (no grab with nothing)
def int LANDGRAB_MOBILE_PCT = 30     // share of our WHOLE army counted as deployable to any spot by air/sea,
                                     // on top of the divisions already adjacent (the engine airlifts and ships)
def int LANDGRAB_REINF_PCT  = 50     // their divisions in THEIR regions adjacent to the spot count this much
                                     // (reinforcements one province away are half a garrison)
// Design rule: opportunity alone is never a casus belli.  landgrab + rivalry
// tops out at 40+20+15 = 75 (+20 roll = 95): it needs one more motive -
// distracted, ally-at-war, outpaced, occupier or accumulated grievance.
// (60/30 made the Iron Curtain a guaranteed war at the end of warm-up.)
def int LANDGRAB_POINTS     = 40     // awarded at the ratio above
def int LANDGRAB_BONUS_PCT  = 300    // ... and this much more if we have >=300%
def int LANDGRAB_BONUS      = 20

// outpaced: their military growth vs ours since last eval, in percent
def int OUTPACED_PCT        = 120    // they grew >=120% of what we grew
def int OUTPACED_MIN_GROWTH = 6      // ...and by at least this many power points (2 divisions)
def int OUTPACED_POINTS     = 45
def int OUTPACED_MEMORY     = 3      // consecutive evals it must persist
def int OUTPACED_MIN_COVERAGE_PCT = 30 // growth is only assessed with at least this much intel
def int STABLE_COVERAGE_DELTA = 5    // ...and only while coverage moved by no more than this since last eval

// fear: their total military vs ours, in percent
def int STRONGER_PCT        = 130    // they have >=130% of our power
def int STRONGER_POINTS     = 70     // subtracted
def int MUCH_STRONGER_PCT   = 200
def int MUCH_STRONGER_POINTS = 60    // subtracted on top

def int DISTRACTED_POINTS   = 25     // rival is at war with a third party we are NOT fighting...
def int DISTRACTED_MIN_EVALS = 2     // ...and has been for at least this many evaluations.  A war that
                                     // started this tick is not yet a distraction; this stops one incident
                                     // cascading into three declarations in the same evaluation.
def int ALLY_AT_WAR_POINTS  = 45     // rival is at war with one of our permanent allies
def int OCCUPIER_POINTS     = 50     // rival holds regions originally ours or an ally's
def int RIVALRY_POINTS      = 15     // rival is on the map's DefaultEnemy list (MAP_RIVALS, stamped by build.ps1)
// Fighting on more than one front is a tall order: the penalty for opening
// ANOTHER war grows with the number we already have.  1 war = -40 for the
// next, 2 wars = -120, 3 = -240 ... so a third front needs an overwhelming
// reason and a fourth is effectively out of reach.
def int COMMITTED_POINTS    = 40     // x wars x (wars+1) / 2, subtracted from every other rival

// grievance accumulators (per evaluation, decaying)
def int BUILDUP_RATIO_PCT   = 150    // their border divisions >=150% of ours...
def int BUILDUP_POINTS      = 15     // ...AND they added more since last eval = mobilisation
                                     // (a big standing garrison is the status quo, not a provocation)
def int OVERFLIGHT_POINTS   = 8      // per visible rival aircraft in our air-defence zone, per eval (snapshot)
def int OVERFLIGHT_MAX      = 32     // cap per eval
def int AIRZONE_KM          = 400    // "our zone" = over our territory, or within this distance of one of
                                     // our radars / airbases WHILE NOT OVER THEIR OWN - loitering just off
                                     // our coast provokes; sitting on their own airfield near the border
                                     // does not, however well we can see it
def int INCURSION_POINTS    = 40     // their ground units inside our borders without a shot fired.
                                     // NOT an immediate war: Region_Invaded fires on mere presence, so
                                     // auto-deploy across a disputed border (India/Pakistan at 0:06) would
                                     // otherwise start a war before the first evaluation.  The occupier
                                     // motive handles ground they actually keep.
def int INCIDENT_POINTS     = 20     // a shot fired at us that destroys nothing: an incident, not a war.
                                     // Auto-engage and stray patrols cause these constantly, so they
                                     // accumulate as grievance instead of opening a war on the spot.
def int GRIEVANCE_DECAY     = 10     // points lost per QUIET evaluation (grudges don't fade while provoked)
def int GRIEVANCE_MAX       = 120
def int GRIEVANCE_SEEN_THRESHOLD = 50 // above this, the blind penalty is halved: we may not see
                                     // their army, but we know who keeps provoking us

// unit weights for "military power" (bucketed: W_SILO also carriers/SSBNs,
// W_AIRPORT also launchpads/mobile ICBMs, W_SUB also cruisers/tactical
// airbases, W_DESTROYER also army bases)
def int W_DIVISION   = 3
def int W_ARMY_BASE  = 1
def int W_SILO       = 5
def int W_LAUNCHPAD  = 4
def int W_MOBILE_ICBM = 4
def int W_AIRPORT    = 4
def int W_TAC_AIRBASE = 2
def int W_CARRIER    = 6
def int W_SSBN       = 5
def int W_SUB        = 3
def int W_CRUISER    = 2
def int W_DESTROYER  = 1


// ------------------------------------------------------------------- state --

def set Rivals            // faction ids we track (everyone with units, not us, not permanent allies)
def set RivalPower        // parallel to Rivals: their (visible) power at last eval
def set RivalGrowthStreak // parallel: consecutive evals in which they out-grew us
def set RivalGrievance    // parallel: current grievance points
def set RivalCoverage     // parallel: our intel coverage of them at last eval (%)
def set RivalBorderDivs   // parallel: their visible divisions on our border at last eval
def set RivalWarStreak    // parallel: consecutive evals they have been at war with a third party
def set RivalStandoff     // parallel: consecutive evals their score sat within reach
def set RivalWarSince     // parallel: EvalCount when our war with them began (-1 = not at war)
def set RivalWarMyRegions // parallel: our region count when that war began
def set RivalWarTheirRegions // parallel: their region count when that war began
def set Released          // ids we have taken off the leash
def set TotalWar          // subset of Released opened with AttackFaction
def set Protected         // ids under peace cooldown (parallel to ProtectedUntil)
def set ProtectedUntil    // evaluation count at which the cooldown ends
def set Pending           // ids we ordered war on, awaiting the engine's WAR_STARTED
def set PendingSince      // evaluation count when the order was given
def set Leashed           // ids we have blocked

def int MyPrevPower = -1
def int Initialised = 0
def int NukeTier = 0          // 0 none, 1 tactical, 2 strategic (ratchet)
def int SaltedAuthorised = 0
def set InitialRegionSet     // the regions we started with (names)
def int InitialProduction = 0 // their total initial production
def int InitialRegions = 0
def int RegionsLostStreak = 0 // consecutive evaluations with enough territory lost
def int EvalCount = 0


// --------------------------------------------------------------- helpers --

// Weighted military power of a faction (as far as we can see it).
// Five bucketed scans instead of one per unit type - this runs for every
// rival of every faction each evaluation, so it dominates the script's cost.
BLOCK int CountTypes(int FactionID, set Types)
  def set Found
  if (INTEL_MODE==1 AND FactionID!=SelfID)
    select units OWNER==FactionID AND PRINCIPAL_TYPE in Types AND VISIBLE_FOR(SelfID) into Found
  else
    select units OWNER==FactionID AND PRINCIPAL_TYPE in Types into Found
  end
  return SIZE_OF(Found)
END

BLOCK int MilitaryPower(int FactionID)
  def int Power = 0
  Power = Power + W_DIVISION * CountTypes(FactionID, {"Army_Division"})
  Power = Power + W_SILO     * CountTypes(FactionID, {"Missile_Silo", "SSBN", "Carrier"})
  Power = Power + W_AIRPORT  * CountTypes(FactionID, {"ICBM_Launchpad", "Mobile_ICBM", "Airport", "Specialized_Airport"})
  Power = Power + W_SUB      * CountTypes(FactionID, {"Submarine", "SSGN", "Cruiser", "Tactical_Airbase"})
  Power = Power + W_DESTROYER * CountTypes(FactionID, {"Destroyer", "Army_Base"})
  return Power
END

// Intel coverage of a rival in percent: how many of their ground units we
// can see out of how many exist.  The total is the only omniscient number in
// this script and it is used purely as a denominator - it never adds to the
// rival's assessed strength.  No units at all = 100% (nothing to miss).
BLOCK int CoveragePct(int FactionID)
  // measured on divisions, not all ground units: bases and radars are
  // trivially visible and would inflate coverage while the army itself is
  // unseen (or still in reserve)
  def set AllDivs
  select units OWNER==FactionID AND PRINCIPAL_TYPE=="Army_Division" into AllDivs
  def int Total = SIZE_OF(AllDivs)
  if (Total<=0)
    return 100
  end
  def set Seen
  select units OWNER==FactionID AND PRINCIPAL_TYPE=="Army_Division" AND VISIBLE_FOR(SelfID) into Seen
  return 100 * SIZE_OF(Seen) / Total
END

// Divisions a faction has inside a given set of region names
BLOCK int DivisionsInRegions(int FactionID, ref set RegionNames)
  if (SIZE_OF(RegionNames)<=0)
    return 0
  end
  def set Found
  if (INTEL_MODE==1 AND FactionID!=SelfID)
    select units OWNER==FactionID AND PRINCIPAL_TYPE=="Army_Division" AND REGION in RegionNames AND VISIBLE_FOR(SelfID) into Found
  else
    select units OWNER==FactionID AND PRINCIPAL_TYPE=="Army_Division" AND REGION in RegionNames into Found
  end
  return SIZE_OF(Found)
END

// Rival aircraft we can see inside our air-defence zone: over our territory,
// or loitering within AIRZONE_KM of one of our radars or airbases (spy planes
// and AWACS parked just off the coast are exactly what a staff resents).
BLOCK int AircraftOverUs(int FactionID)
  def set Found
  select units OWNER==FactionID AND CLASS==Airborne AND VISIBLE_FOR(SelfID) AND TERRITORY==SelfID into Found
  def set Seen
  ForEach unit U in Found
    def int UID = U
    Seen+=UID
  end
  def set Sensors
  select units OWNER==SelfID AND PRINCIPAL_TYPE in {"Fixed_LW_radar", "Over_Horizon_radar", "Airport", "Tactical_Airbase", "Specialized_Airport"} into Sensors
  ForEach unit Sensor in Sensors
    def set Near
    select units OWNER==FactionID AND CLASS==Airborne AND VISIBLE_FOR(SelfID) AND TERRITORY!=FactionID AND DISTANCE(Sensor)<AIRZONE_KM into Near
    ForEach unit N in Near
      def int NID = N
      if (not (NID in Seen))
        Seen+=NID
      end
    end
  end
  return SIZE_OF(Seen)
END

// Regions owned by Owner that touch a region owned by Neighbour
BLOCK ListBorderRegions(int Owner, int Neighbour, ref set Result)
  ForEach string RegName in FACTION_REGIONS(Owner)
    if (ADJACENT_REGIONS(RegName, {Neighbour}))
      Result+=RegName
    end
  end
END

// Does the rival currently hold regions that originally belonged to us or to
// one of our permanent allies?
BLOCK int OccupiesOurSide(int FactionID, ref set MyAllies)
  ForEach string RegName in FACTION_REGIONS(FactionID)
    def int Orig = REGION_ORIGINAL_OWNER(RegName)
    if (Orig!=FactionID)
      if (Orig==SelfID OR (Orig in MyAllies))
        return 1
      end
    end
  end
  return 0
END

// Is the rival at war with one of our permanent allies?
BLOCK int AtWarWithOurAlly(ref set TheirEnemies, ref set MyAllies)
  ForEach int A in MyAllies
    if (A in TheirEnemies)
      return 1
    end
  end
  return 0
END

BLOCK int IndexOfRival(int FactionID)
  def int i = 0
  def int n = SIZE_OF(Rivals)
  while (i<n)
    if (GET_ELEMENT(Rivals, i)==FactionID)
      return i
    end
    i++
  end
  return -1
END

BLOCK Leash(int FactionID)
  if (not (FactionID in Leashed))
    def string TargetName = FACTION_NAME(FactionID)
    BlockAttack TargetName
    BlockInvasion TargetName
    Leashed+=FactionID
  end
END

// The engine drops ALL of a faction's attack blocks when it goes to war (seen
// in a save: BlockedAttackBitscale 1021 -> 0 after LimitedAttack on one
// faction).  BlockAttack is idempotent, so just re-assert the leash on every
// rival that has not been released.
BLOCK ReassertLeash()
  ForEach int R in Rivals
    if (not (R in Released))
      def string RName = FACTION_NAME(R)
      BlockAttack RName
      BlockInvasion RName
    end
  end
END

BLOCK int IsProtected(int FactionID)
  def int i = 0
  def int n = SIZE_OF(Protected)
  while (i<n)
    if (GET_ELEMENT(Protected, i)==FactionID)
      if (GET_ELEMENT(ProtectedUntil, i)>EvalCount)
        return 1
      end
    end
    i++
  end
  return 0
END

BLOCK Protect(int FactionID, string Reason)
  Released-=FactionID
  TotalWar-=FactionID
  Pending-=FactionID
  Leashed-=FactionID
  Leash(FactionID)
  Protected+=FactionID
  ProtectedUntil+=(EvalCount + PEACE_COOLDOWN_EVALS)
  if (DEBUG_MESSAGES>=1)
    def string MyName = FACTION_NAME(SelfID)
    def string TName = FACTION_NAME(FactionID)
    Message MyName + " stands down against " + TName + ": " + Reason Position TopLeft
  end
END

// Wind a war down from our side: ask the engine for a ceasefire, stop
// prosecuting the war, re-leash, and hold the peace cooldown so nothing
// re-declares immediately.
//
// `CeaseFire With "X"` is the verified statement (probe 4): the grammar is
// strict - `Peace "X"`, `Peace Treaty "X"`, `Peace With "X"` and any
// trailing duration are all parse errors, while `CeaseFire With "X"` and
// `Peace Treaty With "X"` both work and both produce a ceasefire of the
// game's default length.
BLOCK StandDownFrom(int FactionID, string Reason)
  def string TargetName = FACTION_NAME(FactionID)
  CeaseFire With TargetName
  Protect(FactionID, Reason)
END

BLOCK ReleaseWith(int FactionID, string Reason, int Mode)
  if (IsProtected(FactionID)==1)
    // under a peace cooldown: scored declarations are refused.  Retaliate()
    // clears the protection first, so a real attack is still answered.
  else
  // a war already being fought in limited mode can be escalated to full
  def int Escalate = 0
  if ((FactionID in Released) AND Mode==2 AND not (FactionID in TotalWar))
    Escalate = 1
  end

  if ((not (FactionID in Released)) OR Escalate==1)
    def string TargetName = FACTION_NAME(FactionID)
    Released+=FactionID
    Leashed-=FactionID
    if (Mode==2)
      TotalWar+=FactionID
    end
    if (not (FactionID in Pending))
      Pending+=FactionID
      PendingSince+=EvalCount
    end

    // Probe results (2026-09-20, read from saves):
    //   AllowAttack X    - does NOTHING in this build
    //   LimitedAttack X  - clears X's block bit, declares war, limited escalation
    //   AttackFaction X  - clears X's block bit, declares war, forces global attack
    //   Declare War X    - declares war but X stays blocked
    // So "releasing the leash" IS the declaration of war.
    // ENGINE: one war mode per faction, last command wins - a LimitedAttack
    // issued for a retaliation clears an AttackFaction already in force
    // against someone else (seen in a save: NATO's full war on the US was
    // reset by its limited replies to two other attackers).  So a faction
    // with ANY full war fights ALL its wars fully.
    if (SIZE_OF(TotalWar)>0)
      AttackFaction TargetName
    else
      LimitedAttack TargetName
    end
    if (Mode==2)
      AllowInvasion TargetName
    end
    // ENGINE (probe 3): going to war wipes ALL of this faction's attack
    // blocks, and a BlockAttack issued in the SAME tick after the war order
    // freezes the faction (no orders, war dropped).  A re-block two minutes
    // later holds and keeps the war going.  So the leash on everyone else
    // is restored on a delay, never here.
    ON TICK +MINUTES(2) ReassertLeash()

    if (DEBUG_MESSAGES>=1)
      def string MyName = FACTION_NAME(SelfID)
      def string Verb = " opens limited war on "
      if (Mode==2)
        Verb = " declares war on "
      end
      if (Escalate==1)
        Verb = " escalates to invasion of "
      end
      Message MyName + Verb + TargetName + ": " + Reason Position TopLeft
    end
  end
  end // not protected
END

// decided by the motive score; the mode was chosen from the motives present
BLOCK Release(int FactionID, string Reason, int Mode)
  ReleaseWith(FactionID, Reason, Mode)
END

// hitting back at a real attack: never refused by a peace cooldown
BLOCK Retaliate(int FactionID, string Reason)
  Protected-=FactionID
  ReleaseWith(FactionID, Reason, RETALIATION_MODE)
END

// Someone attacked our units.  Being attacked does NOT put us at war by
// itself - the engine expects the victim's AI to declare war, and our leash
// stops it from doing that.  So drop the leash on the attacker and let the
// engine's own retaliation logic decide the response.  Called from hooks with
// LITERAL faction names stamped by build.ps1 (a variable argument would be
// re-evaluated when the event fires).
// Add to our grievance against one faction (parallel sets are rebuilt in
// place; there is no element assignment in this language).
BLOCK AddGrievance(int FactionID, int Points)
  def int idx = IndexOfRival(FactionID)
  if (idx>=0)
    def set Rebuilt
    def int i = 0
    def int n = SIZE_OF(RivalGrievance)
    while (i<n)
      def int V = GET_ELEMENT(RivalGrievance, i)
      if (i==idx)
        V = V + Points
        if (V>GRIEVANCE_MAX)
          V = GRIEVANCE_MAX
        end
      end
      Rebuilt+=V
      i++
    end
    RivalGrievance = Rebuilt
  end
END

// A shot that destroyed nothing: log it as a grievance and let it accumulate.
// Repeated incidents will eventually earn a punitive war through the normal
// scoring; a single auto-engage will not.
BLOCK OnIncidentBy(string AttackerName)
  def int A = FACTION_ID(AttackerName)
  if (A!=SelfID AND not (A in Released))
    AddGrievance(A, INCIDENT_POINTS)
  end
END

// Their units are inside our borders but nothing has been destroyed: a
// serious grievance, not yet a war.
BLOCK OnIncursionBy(string AttackerName)
  def int A = FACTION_ID(AttackerName)
  if (A!=SelfID AND not (A in Released))
    AddGrievance(A, INCURSION_POINTS)
  end
END

// Something of ours was destroyed: hit back now.
BLOCK OnAttackedBy(string AttackerName)
  def int A = FACTION_ID(AttackerName)
  if (A!=SelfID AND not (A in Released))
    Retaliate(A, "attacked us")
  end
END

// A war involving us has started (fired by the engine, e.g. because someone
// attacked us).  Takes NO arguments on purpose: event handler arguments are
// evaluated when the event fires, not when it is registered, so a loop
// variable passed in would always hold its last value.  Instead we ask the
// engine who we are hostile with right now and make sure none of them is
// still leashed - the leash must never stop us from fighting back.
// Mutual defence: if the engine put us at war with someone who is also
// fighting one of our permanent allies, that is an alliance war and we
// commit fully; anything else is answered with limited operations.
BLOCK RespondToWar(int T)
  def set MyAllies = GET_PERMANENT_ALLIES(SelfID)
  def set TheirEnemies = GET_ENEMIES(T)
  if (AtWarWithOurAlly(TheirEnemies, MyAllies)==1)
    ReleaseWith(T, "defending ally", 2)
  else
    Retaliate(T, "at war")
  end
END

BLOCK OnHostilities()
  ForEach int T in Rivals
    if (not (T in Released))
      if (ENEMIES(SelfID, T))
        RespondToWar(T)
      end
    end
  end
END


// ------------------------------------------------------------ discovery --

// Register every faction on the map (ALL_FACTIONS is stamped by build.ps1)
// and leash any we have not seen before.  NOT unit-based: a faction whose
// units are still in reserve (typically the human in the first minutes) has
// no deployed ground units and would otherwise go unleashed - which is
// exactly how NATO got to invade Alaska at minute 11.
BLOCK DiscoverRivals()
  def string MyName = FACTION_NAME(SelfID)
  def int Added = 0

  ForEach string OwnerName in ALL_FACTIONS
    def int O = FACTION_ID(OwnerName)
    if (O>=0 AND O!=SelfID AND not (OwnerName in IGNORED_FACTIONS))
      if (not PERMANENT_ALLIES(O, SelfID))
        if (not (O in Rivals))
          Rivals+=O
          RivalPower+=MilitaryPower(O)
          RivalGrowthStreak+=0
          RivalGrievance+=0
          RivalCoverage+=0
          RivalBorderDivs+=0
          RivalWarStreak+=0
          RivalStandoff+=0
          RivalWarSince+=(0 - 1)
          RivalWarMyRegions+=0
          RivalWarTheirRegions+=0
          Added++

          Leash(O)

          // if a war with them starts (they attacked us), drop the leash
          ON WAR_STARTED BETWEEN MyName AND OwnerName OnHostilities()
        end
      end
    end
  end

  if (Initialised==0 AND SIZE_OF(Rivals)>0)
    MyPrevPower = MilitaryPower(SelfID)
    Initialised = 1

    if (DEBUG_MESSAGES>=2)
      def int NumRivals = SIZE_OF(Rivals)
      Message MyName + " war-motives online, tracking " + NumRivals + " rivals, power " + MyPrevPower Position TopLeft
    end
  else
    if (Added>0 AND DEBUG_MESSAGES>=2)
      def int NumRivals = SIZE_OF(Rivals)
      Message MyName + " now tracking " + NumRivals + " rivals" Position TopLeft
    end
  end
END


// ------------------------------------------------------------ evaluation --

BLOCK EvaluateRivals()
  EvalCount++

  def int MyPower = MilitaryPower(SelfID)
  def int MyGrowth = MyPower - MyPrevPower
  if (MyGrowth<1)
    MyGrowth = 1        // avoid divide-by-zero; treat no growth as tiny growth
  end

  def set MyAllies = GET_PERMANENT_ALLIES(SelfID)

  def set NewPower
  def set NewStreak
  def set NewGrievance
  def set NewCoverage
  def set NewBorderDivs
  def set NewWarStreak
  def set NewStandoff
  def set NewWarSince
  def set NewWarMyRegions
  def set NewWarTheirRegions

  // for the one-line debug summary
  def int BestScore = -9999
  def string BestName = ""
  def string BestWhy = ""

  def int idx = 0
  def int n = SIZE_OF(Rivals)

  while (idx<n)
    def int T = GET_ELEMENT(Rivals, idx)
    def int TPrevPower = GET_ELEMENT(RivalPower, idx)
    def int TStreak = GET_ELEMENT(RivalGrowthStreak, idx)
    def int TGrievance = GET_ELEMENT(RivalGrievance, idx)
    def int TPrevCoverage = GET_ELEMENT(RivalCoverage, idx)
    def int TPrevBorderDivs = GET_ELEMENT(RivalBorderDivs, idx)
    def int TWarStreak = GET_ELEMENT(RivalWarStreak, idx)
    def int TStandoff = GET_ELEMENT(RivalStandoff, idx)
    def int TWarSince = GET_ELEMENT(RivalWarSince, idx)
    def int TWarMyRegions = GET_ELEMENT(RivalWarMyRegions, idx)
    def int TWarTheirRegions = GET_ELEMENT(RivalWarTheirRegions, idx)

    def int TPower = MilitaryPower(T)
    def int TGrowth = TPower - TPrevPower

    def int Score = 0
    def string Why = ""
    def int Territorial = 0   // landgrab / occupier fired this evaluation
    def int AllyWar = 0       // ally-at-war fired
    def int Provoked = 0      // new grievance added this evaluation

    // A permanent ally (alliances can form mid-game) is never scored or
    // released; its bookkeeping still ticks along below.
    def int IsAlly = 0
    if (T in MyAllies)
      IsAlly = 1
      Why = " ally"
    end
    if (PARTNERS_EXEMPT==1 AND IsAlly==0)
      if (GET_RELATIONS(SelfID, T)==2)
        IsAlly = 1
        Why = " partner"
      end
    end
    // the watched faction gets a line even when exempt, so the exemption
    // is visible rather than silent
    if (IsAlly==1 AND DEBUG_MESSAGES>=2)
      def string TNameEx = FACTION_NAME(T)
      if (TNameEx==DEBUG_WATCH)
        def string MyNameEx = FACTION_NAME(SelfID)
        Message MyNameEx + " vs " + TNameEx + " = exempt [" + Why + " ]" Position TopLeft
      end
    end

    // carried into the bookkeeping below, so declared outside the block
    def int Coverage = 100
    def int MyBorderDivs = 0
    def int TheirBorderDivs = 0

    if (IsAlly==0)

    // ---- safety net: if the engine says we are already at war with them,
    //      the leash must be off (covers a missed WAR_STARTED event)
    if (not (T in Released))
      if (ENEMIES(SelfID, T))
        RespondToWar(T)
      end
    end

    // ---- stalemate: has this war gone anywhere?
    def int AtWarNow = 0
    if (ENEMIES(SelfID, T))
      AtWarNow = 1
    end
    def int MyRegionsNow = SIZE_OF(FACTION_REGIONS(SelfID))
    def int TheirRegionsNow = SIZE_OF(FACTION_REGIONS(T))
    if (AtWarNow==1)
      if (TWarSince<0)
        TWarSince = EvalCount
        TWarMyRegions = MyRegionsNow
        TWarTheirRegions = TheirRegionsNow
      end
      if (EvalCount-TWarSince>=STALEMATE_EVALS)
        def int MyGain = MyRegionsNow - TWarMyRegions
        def int TheirGain = TheirRegionsNow - TWarTheirRegions
        if (MyGain<=STALEMATE_GAIN_PCT AND TheirGain<=STALEMATE_GAIN_PCT)
          def int Duration = EvalCount - TWarSince
          StandDownFrom(T, "stalemate: " + Duration + " evaluations, no ground taken")
          TWarSince = 0 - 1
        end
      end
    else
      TWarSince = 0 - 1
    end

    // ---- intel coverage of them (drives land grab and the blind penalty)
    if (INTEL_MODE==1)
      Coverage = CoveragePct(T)
    end

    // A jump in coverage makes more of their units visible - that is us
    // learning, not them growing.  Growth-type motives only count while
    // coverage is steady.
    def int CoverageDelta = Coverage - TPrevCoverage
    if (CoverageDelta<0)
      CoverageDelta = 0 - CoverageDelta
    end
    def int CoverageStable = 0
    if (CoverageDelta<=STABLE_COVERAGE_DELTA)
      CoverageStable = 1
    end

    // our whole army, for the mobile share used in the land-grab check
    def set MyAllDivs
    select units OWNER==SelfID AND PRINCIPAL_TYPE=="Army_Division" into MyAllDivs
    def int MyMobile = SIZE_OF(MyAllDivs) * LANDGRAB_MOBILE_PCT / 100

    // ---- shared border forces (used by land grab AND build-up grievance)
    def set MyBorder
    def set TheirBorder
    ListBorderRegions(SelfID, T, MyBorder)
    ListBorderRegions(T, SelfID, TheirBorder)

    if (SIZE_OF(TheirBorder)>0)
      MyBorderDivs = DivisionsInRegions(SelfID, MyBorder)
      TheirBorderDivs = DivisionsInRegions(T, TheirBorder)

      // land grab - per REGION, not aggregate: the weakest spot along the
      // border, judged by their (visible) divisions in that region against
      // ours in our regions adjacent to it.  An aggregate ratio lets a
      // faction hide an empty Alaska behind a stacked lower-48 border.
      // Only if we actually have eyes on them: with no intel the visible
      // count is 0 and everyone looks like a pushover.
      if (Coverage>=LANDGRAB_MIN_COVERAGE_PCT)
        def int BestPct = 0
        def string BestRegion = ""
        def string BestDetail = ""
        def int BestMine = 0
        ForEach string R in TheirBorder
          def set ThisRegion = {R}
          def int TheirHere = DivisionsInRegions(T, ThisRegion)
          def set MyAdjacent
          def set TheirAdjacent
          ForEach string A in ADJACENT_REGIONS(R)
            def int AOwner = REGION_OWNER(A)
            if (AOwner==SelfID)
              MyAdjacent+=A
            end
            if (AOwner==T)
              TheirAdjacent+=A
            end
          end
          def int MineAdjacent = DivisionsInRegions(SelfID, MyAdjacent) + MyMobile
          def int TheirReinf = DivisionsInRegions(T, TheirAdjacent)
          if (MineAdjacent>=LANDGRAB_MIN_OWN_DIVS)
            // garrison + discounted reinforcements from their neighbouring provinces
            def int TheirSafe = TheirHere + (TheirReinf * LANDGRAB_REINF_PCT / 100)
            if (TheirSafe<1)
              TheirSafe = 1
            end
            def int Pct = 100 * MineAdjacent / TheirSafe
            if (Pct>BestPct)
              BestPct = Pct
              BestRegion = R
              BestDetail = (MineAdjacent - MyMobile) + "+" + MyMobile + "v" + TheirHere + "+" + TheirReinf + "/2"
            end
          end
          if (MineAdjacent>BestMine)
            BestMine = MineAdjacent
          end
        end
        if (BestPct>=LANDGRAB_RATIO_PCT)
          Score = Score + LANDGRAB_POINTS
          Why = Why + " landgrab(" + BestRegion + " " + BestPct + "% " + BestDetail + ")"
          Territorial = 1
          if (BestPct>=LANDGRAB_BONUS_PCT)
            Score = Score + LANDGRAB_BONUS
          end
        else
          // diagnostics: why not?  (mine-adjacent+mobile v their-garrison + reinforcements/2)
          if (BestPct>0)
            Why = Why + " spot(" + BestRegion + " " + BestPct + "% " + BestDetail + ")"
          else
            Why = Why + " no-spot(max " + BestMine + " adjacent)"
          end
        end
      end

      // their build-up on our frontier -> grievance
      def int MySafe = MyBorderDivs
      if (MySafe<1)
        MySafe = 1
      end
      def int TheirPct = 100 * TheirBorderDivs / MySafe
      if (CoverageStable==1 AND TheirBorderDivs>TPrevBorderDivs AND TheirPct>=BUILDUP_RATIO_PCT)
        TGrievance = TGrievance + BUILDUP_POINTS
        Provoked = 1
        Why = Why + " buildup(+" + (TheirBorderDivs - TPrevBorderDivs) + ")"
      end
    end

    // ---- their aircraft over our territory -> grievance
    def int Overflights = AircraftOverUs(T) * OVERFLIGHT_POINTS
    if (Overflights>OVERFLIGHT_MAX)
      Overflights = OVERFLIGHT_MAX
    end
    if (Overflights>0)
      TGrievance = TGrievance + Overflights
      Provoked = 1
      Why = Why + " overflights"
    end

    // ---- outpaced: their military growth vs ours, must persist.  Only
    //      assessed with decent, steady intel; otherwise the streak just holds.
    def int GrowthPct = 100 * TGrowth / MyGrowth
    if (CoverageStable==1 AND Coverage>=OUTPACED_MIN_COVERAGE_PCT)
      if (TGrowth>=OUTPACED_MIN_GROWTH AND GrowthPct>=OUTPACED_PCT)
        TStreak++
      else
        TStreak = 0
      end
    end
    if (TStreak>=OUTPACED_MEMORY)
      Score = Score + OUTPACED_POINTS
      Why = Why + " outpaced(x" + TStreak + ")"
    end

    // ---- fear: their total (visible) power vs ours
    def int MyPowerSafe = MyPower
    if (MyPowerSafe<1)
      MyPowerSafe = 1
    end
    def int PowerPct = 100 * TPower / MyPowerSafe
    if (PowerPct>=STRONGER_PCT)
      Score = Score - STRONGER_POINTS
      Why = Why + " stronger(" + PowerPct + "%)"
      if (PowerPct>=MUCH_STRONGER_PCT)
        Score = Score - MUCH_STRONGER_POINTS
      end
    end

    // ---- blind: poor intel coverage of them (halved if they keep provoking
    //      us - we know who they are even if we cannot count their army)
    if (INTEL_MODE==1)
      if (Coverage<BLIND_COVERAGE_PCT)
        if (TGrievance>=GRIEVANCE_SEEN_THRESHOLD)
          Score = Score - BLIND_POINTS / 2
        else
          Score = Score - BLIND_POINTS
        end
        Why = Why + " blind(" + Coverage + "%)"
      end
    end

    // ---- their wars: distracted by a third party / fighting our ally.
    //      "Distracted" means their forces are tied up somewhere WE are not:
    //      a shared enemy is not a distraction, it is a common front.
    def set TheirEnemies = GET_ENEMIES(T)
    TheirEnemies-=SelfID
    def set MyEnemies = GET_ENEMIES(SelfID)
    def set TheirOtherWars
    ForEach int E in TheirEnemies
      if (not (E in MyEnemies))
        TheirOtherWars+=E
      end
    end
    if (SIZE_OF(TheirOtherWars)>0)
      TWarStreak++
      if (TWarStreak>=DISTRACTED_MIN_EVALS)
        Score = Score + DISTRACTED_POINTS
        Why = Why + " distracted"
      else
        Why = Why + " (at-war " + TWarStreak + "/" + DISTRACTED_MIN_EVALS + ")"
      end
      if (AtWarWithOurAlly(TheirOtherWars, MyAllies)==1)
        Score = Score + ALLY_AT_WAR_POINTS
        Why = Why + " ally-at-war"
        AllyWar = 1
      end
    else
      TWarStreak = 0
    end

    // ---- they sit on our land or an ally's
    if (OccupiesOurSide(T, MyAllies)==1)
      Score = Score + OCCUPIER_POINTS
      Why = Why + " occupier"
      Territorial = 1
    end

    // ---- old rivalry from the map
    def string TNameForRivalry = FACTION_NAME(T)
    if (TNameForRivalry in MAP_RIVALS)
      Score = Score + RIVALRY_POINTS
      Why = Why + " rivalry"
    end

    // ---- accumulated grievance (capped, decays)
    if (TGrievance>GRIEVANCE_MAX)
      TGrievance = GRIEVANCE_MAX
    end
    if (TGrievance>0)
      Score = Score + TGrievance
      Why = Why + " grievance(" + TGrievance + ")"
      if (Provoked==0)
        TGrievance = TGrievance - GRIEVANCE_DECAY
        if (TGrievance<0)
          TGrievance = 0
        end
      end
    end

    // ---- already committed elsewhere (read live: a release earlier in this
    //      same pass must count against every rival evaluated after it)
    def int Committed = 0
    ForEach int R in Released
      if (ENEMIES(SelfID, R))
        Committed++
      end
    end
    if (Committed>0 AND not (T in Released))
      def int Penalty = COMMITTED_POINTS * Committed * (Committed + 1) / 2
      Score = Score - Penalty
      Why = Why + " committed(" + Committed + " wars, -" + Penalty + ")"
    end

    // ---- standoff pressure
    if (Score>=STANDOFF_MIN_SCORE AND Score<WAR_THRESHOLD AND not (T in Released))
      TStandoff++
    else
      TStandoff = 0
    end
    def int Impatient = 0
    if (TStandoff>=STANDOFF_EVALS)
      Why = Why + " standoff(" + TStandoff + ")"
      if (RAND(100)<STANDOFF_CHANCE_PCT)
        Impatient = 1
      end
    end

    // ---- decision
    def int Roll = RAND(RANDOM_FUDGE + 1)
    def int Final = Score + Roll
    if (Impatient==1 AND Final<WAR_THRESHOLD)
      Final = WAR_THRESHOLD
      Why = Why + " lost-patience"
    end
    def int WarmedUp = 0
    if (CURRENT_TICK>=MINUTES(WARMUP_MIN))
      WarmedUp = 1
    end
    if (Final>=WAR_THRESHOLD AND WarmedUp==0)
      Why = Why + " (warm-up)"
    end

    if (not (T in Released))
      def string TNameDbg = FACTION_NAME(T)
      if (DEBUG_MESSAGES>=3 OR (DEBUG_MESSAGES==2 AND TNameDbg==DEBUG_WATCH))
        def string MyName = FACTION_NAME(SelfID)
        Message MyName + " vs " + TNameDbg + " = " + Final + " [" + Why + " ]" Position TopLeft
      end
      if (Final>BestScore)
        BestScore = Final
        BestName = FACTION_NAME(T)
        BestWhy = Why
      end
    end

    if (IsProtected(T)==1)
      Why = Why + " (peace cooldown)"
    end
    if (Final>=WAR_THRESHOLD AND WarmedUp==1 AND IsProtected(T)==0)
      def int Mode = MODE_PUNITIVE
      if (AllyWar==1)
        Mode = MODE_ALLY_AT_WAR
      end
      if (Territorial==1)
        Mode = MODE_TERRITORIAL
      end
      // Release() ignores factions already released, EXCEPT to escalate a
      // limited war to a full one when a territorial motive now carries it
      Release(T, Why, Mode)
    end

    end // IsAlly==0

    NewPower+=TPower
    NewStreak+=TStreak
    NewGrievance+=TGrievance
    NewCoverage+=Coverage
    NewBorderDivs+=TheirBorderDivs
    NewWarStreak+=TWarStreak
    NewStandoff+=TStandoff
    NewWarSince+=TWarSince
    NewWarMyRegions+=TWarMyRegions
    NewWarTheirRegions+=TWarTheirRegions

    idx++
  end

  RivalPower = NewPower
  RivalGrowthStreak = NewStreak
  RivalGrievance = NewGrievance
  RivalCoverage = NewCoverage
  RivalBorderDivs = NewBorderDivs
  RivalWarStreak = NewWarStreak
  RivalStandoff = NewStandoff
  RivalWarSince = NewWarSince
  RivalWarMyRegions = NewWarMyRegions
  RivalWarTheirRegions = NewWarTheirRegions
  MyPrevPower = MyPower

  if (DEBUG_MESSAGES>=2 AND BestScore>-9999)
    def string MyName = FACTION_NAME(SelfID)
    Message MyName + " (pwr " + MyPower + ") top: " + BestName + " " + BestScore + "/" + WAR_THRESHOLD + " [" + BestWhy + " ]" Position TopLeft
  end
END

// Periodic entry point: first call discovers the rivals (units exist by then),
// every later call scores them.
// LimitedAttack and AttackFaction are ONE-SHOT orders in this engine (the
// block bit and mode bits are restored once the operation is over), so the
// faction's war mode is re-issued every evaluation for every current enemy -
// in ONE pass after scoring, so nothing clobbers it mid-evaluation.  One mode
// per faction: full if any war was opened for territorial reasons.
BLOCK ReissueWars()
  def int Reissued = 0
  // wars the engine has ended, or declarations it refused
  def set Ended
  ForEach int T in Released
    if (not ENEMIES(SelfID, T))
      def int Since = -1
      def int i = 0
      def int n = SIZE_OF(Pending)
      while (i<n)
        if (GET_ELEMENT(Pending, i)==T)
          Since = GET_ELEMENT(PendingSince, i)
        end
        i++
      end
      if (Since<0 OR EvalCount>=Since+2)
        Ended+=T
      end
    else
      Pending-=T
    end
  end
  ForEach int T in Ended
    Protect(T, "war ended or refused by the engine")
  end
  ForEach int T in Released
    if (ENEMIES(SelfID, T))
      def string TNameWar = FACTION_NAME(T)
      if (SIZE_OF(TotalWar)>0)
        AttackFaction TNameWar
      else
        LimitedAttack TNameWar
      end
      Reissued = 1
    end
  end
  // A re-issued LimitedAttack wipes the faction's blocks again (seen in a
  // save: every limited-war faction at 0, every full-war faction intact).
  // Restore the leash on the proven two-minute delay - never in this tick.
  if (Reissued==1)
    ON TICK +MINUTES(2) ReassertLeash()
  end
END

// Order matters (probe 3): blocks BEFORE war orders in a tick are fine,
// blocks AFTER a war order in the same tick freeze the faction.
// ------------------------------------------------------- nuclear doctrine --

BLOCK int AtWarWithAnyone()
  def set E = GET_ENEMIES(SelfID)
  if (SIZE_OF(E)>0)
    return 1
  end
  return 0
END

BLOCK AuthoriseTactical(string Reason)
  if (NukeTier<1)
    NukeTier = 1
    // geneva (warhead) categories are the form the campaign proves in play;
    // the ai_category form is kept alongside (it parses; effect unverified)
    ENABLE Missiles geneva "Offensive Tactical Nukes" FOR ME
    ENABLE Missiles geneva "Defencive Tactical Nukes" FOR ME
    ENABLE Missiles geneva "Light Gravity Bombs" FOR ME
    ENABLE Missiles geneva "EMP Weapons" FOR ME   // area denial, not a city-killer
    ENABLE Missiles ai_category "Tactical Nuclear" FOR ME
    def set AllArmies
    select units OWNER==SelfID AND PRINCIPAL_TYPE in {"Army_Division", "Army_Base"} into AllArmies
    Unit AllArmies WEAPON_USE "Nuclear Artillery" Always
    Unit AllArmies WEAPON_USE "Fusion Artillery" Always
    if (DEBUG_MESSAGES>=1)
      def string MyName = FACTION_NAME(SelfID)
      Message MyName + " authorises TACTICAL nuclear weapons: " + Reason Position TopLeft
    end
  end
END

BLOCK AuthoriseStrategic(string Reason)
  if (NukeTier<2)
    AuthoriseTactical(Reason)
    NukeTier = 2
    ENABLE Missiles geneva "High-Yield Nukes" FOR ME
    ENABLE Missiles geneva "Basic Fission Weapons" FOR ME
    ENABLE Missiles geneva "Nuclear MIRV" FOR ME
    ENABLE Missiles ai_category "Basic Nuclear" FOR ME
    ENABLE Missiles ai_category "Small MIRV" FOR ME
    ENABLE Missiles ai_category "Strategic Nuclear" FOR ME
    ENABLE Missiles ai_category "SLBM" FOR ME
    if (DEBUG_MESSAGES>=1)
      def string MyName = FACTION_NAME(SelfID)
      Message MyName + " authorises STRATEGIC nuclear weapons: " + Reason Position TopLeft
    end
  end
END

BLOCK AuthoriseSalted(string Reason)
  if (SaltedAuthorised==0)
    SaltedAuthorised = 1
    AuthoriseStrategic(Reason)
    ENABLE Missiles geneva "Salted Weapons" FOR ME
    ENABLE Missiles ai_category "Salted Weapons" FOR ME
    if (DEBUG_MESSAGES>=1)
      def string MyName = FACTION_NAME(SelfID)
      Message MyName + " authorises SALTED weapons: " + Reason Position TopLeft
    end
  end
END

// Baseline for the existential test, taken on the first evaluation.
BLOCK NuclearBaseline()
  if (InitialRegions==0)
    InitialRegionSet = FACTION_REGIONS(SelfID)
    InitialRegions = SIZE_OF(InitialRegionSet)
    ForEach string R in InitialRegionSet
      InitialProduction = InitialProduction + STAT("REGION_INITIAL_PRODUCTION", REGION_ID(R))
    end
  end
END

BLOCK EvaluateNuclearDoctrine()
  if (NUCLEAR_DOCTRINE==1)
    NuclearBaseline()
    if (AtWarWithAnyone()==1)
      // ---- tier 1: a region of ours WORTH DEFENDING is being invaded and we
      //      may not hold it - or we have already lost regions outright
      if (NukeTier<1)
        def int LostNow = 0
        ForEach string R in InitialRegionSet
          if (REGION_OWNER(R)!=SelfID)
            LostNow++
          end
        end
        if (LostNow>=TACTICAL_REGIONS_LOST)
          AuthoriseTactical(LostNow + " regions already lost")
        end
      end
      if (NukeTier<1)
        def set Invaders
        select units ENEMY(SelfID) AND CLASS==Ground AND TERRITORY==SelfID into Invaders
        if (SIZE_OF(Invaders)>0)
          ForEach string R in FACTION_REGIONS(SelfID)
            def set Inv
            select units ENEMY(SelfID) AND CLASS==Ground AND REGION==R into Inv
            def int NumInv = SIZE_OF(Inv)
            if (NumInv>0)
              def int RProd = STAT("REGION_INITIAL_PRODUCTION", REGION_ID(R))
              def int Valuable = 0
              if (InitialProduction>0 AND 100*RProd>=TACTICAL_REGION_PCT*InitialProduction)
                Valuable = 1
              end
              if (Valuable==1)
                def set One = {R}
                def int Defenders = DivisionsInRegions(SelfID, One)
                def int DefSafe = Defenders
                if (DefSafe<1)
                  DefSafe = 1
                end
                def int Pct = 100 * NumInv / DefSafe
                if (Pct>=TACTICAL_HOLD_RATIO_PCT)
                  AuthoriseTactical("holding " + R + " (" + NumInv + " invaders v " + Defenders + " defenders)")
                  break
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      // ---- tier 2: existential = lost territory
      if (NukeTier<2)
        def int Lost = 0
        def string BigLoss = ""
        ForEach string R in InitialRegionSet
          if (REGION_OWNER(R)!=SelfID)
            Lost++
            def int RProd = STAT("REGION_INITIAL_PRODUCTION", REGION_ID(R))
            if (InitialProduction>0 AND 100*RProd>=STRATEGIC_REGION_PCT*InitialProduction)
              BigLoss = R
            end
          end
        end
        if (Lost>=EXIST_REGIONS_LOST AND 100*Lost>=EXIST_REGIONS_PCT*InitialRegions)
          RegionsLostStreak++
        else
          RegionsLostStreak = 0
        end
        if (RegionsLostStreak>=EXIST_HOLD_EVALS)
          AuthoriseStrategic("existential: " + Lost + " of " + InitialRegions + " regions lost and held")
        end
        if (BigLoss!="")
          AuthoriseStrategic("existential: strategic region " + BigLoss + " lost")
        end
      end
    end
  end
END

BLOCK EvaluateWarMotives()
  DiscoverRivals()
  if (Initialised==1)
    // blocks are only ever wiped by our own war orders, and those schedule
    // their own delayed re-block - the per-evaluation safety net is only
    // worth its planner cost while we are actually at war
    if (SIZE_OF(Released)>0)
      ReassertLeash()
    end
    EvaluateRivals()
    ReissueWars()
    EvaluateNuclearDoctrine()
  end
END


// Registered from a tick handler so each faction starts its evaluation
// cycle at its own offset.  Must be defined AFTER EvaluateWarMotives: an
// event registration names its handler, and the parser only knows blocks
// defined above it.
BLOCK StartEvaluations()
  ON EACH TICK +MINUTES(EVAL_PERIOD_MIN) EvaluateWarMotives()
END


// -------------------------------------------------------------- entry --

BLOCK SetWarMotives()
  // Leash the map-defined default enemies at tick 0 (no units needed for
  // that), then pick up everyone else as soon as units are on the map.
  ForEach int E in GET_ENEMIES(SelfID)
    Leash(E)
  end

  // nuclear doctrine: everything nuclear withheld until a tier is earned,
  // or until it is used on us (in kind)
  if (NUCLEAR_DOCTRINE==1)
    DISABLE Missiles geneva "Offensive Tactical Nukes" FOR ME
    DISABLE Missiles geneva "Defencive Tactical Nukes" FOR ME
    DISABLE Missiles geneva "Light Gravity Bombs" FOR ME
    DISABLE Missiles geneva "High-Yield Nukes" FOR ME
    DISABLE Missiles geneva "Basic Fission Weapons" FOR ME
    DISABLE Missiles geneva "Nuclear MIRV" FOR ME
    DISABLE Missiles geneva "Salted Weapons" FOR ME
    DISABLE Missiles geneva "EMP Weapons" FOR ME
    DISABLE Missiles ai_category "Tactical Nuclear" FOR ME
    DISABLE Missiles ai_category "Basic Nuclear" FOR ME
    DISABLE Missiles ai_category "Small MIRV" FOR ME
    DISABLE Missiles ai_category "Strategic Nuclear" FOR ME
    DISABLE Missiles ai_category "SLBM" FOR ME
    DISABLE Missiles ai_category "Salted Weapons" FOR ME
    // In-kind tiers are chosen by what the weapon IS, not by its yield
    // label: 100kt/250kt ALBMs are AI-category Tactical Nuclear but carry
    // the "High-Yield Nukes" geneva tag, and using that tag for the
    // strategic trigger promoted whole factions for being shelled.
    // Strategic promotes only on categories that appear on no tactical
    // weapon; everything else is answered in tactical kind.
    on attacked anything by ai_category "Tactical Nuclear" AuthoriseTactical("in kind")
    on attacked anything by geneva "Offensive Tactical Nukes" AuthoriseTactical("in kind")
    on attacked anything by geneva "Defencive Tactical Nukes" AuthoriseTactical("in kind")
    on attacked anything by geneva "Light Gravity Bombs" AuthoriseTactical("in kind")
    on attacked anything by geneva "EMP Weapons" AuthoriseTactical("in kind")
    on attacked anything by geneva "High-Yield Nukes" AuthoriseTactical("in kind")
    on attacked anything by geneva "Basic Fission Weapons" AuthoriseTactical("in kind")
    on attacked anything by geneva "Heavy Gravity Bombs" AuthoriseStrategic("in kind")
    on attacked anything by geneva "Nuclear MIRV" AuthoriseStrategic("in kind")
    on attacked anything by geneva "Heavy ICBM MIRV" AuthoriseStrategic("in kind")
    on attacked anything by geneva "Light ICBM MIRV" AuthoriseStrategic("in kind")
    on attacked anything by geneva "MRBM MIRV" AuthoriseStrategic("in kind")
    on attacked anything by geneva "SLBM MIRV" AuthoriseStrategic("in kind")
    on attacked anything by geneva "Unitary Heavy Nuclear ICBM" AuthoriseStrategic("in kind")
    on attacked anything by geneva "Unitary Light Nuclear ICBM" AuthoriseStrategic("in kind")
    on attacked anything by geneva "Unitary Nuclear MRBM" AuthoriseStrategic("in kind")
    on attacked anything by geneva "Unitary Nuclear SLBM" AuthoriseStrategic("in kind")
    on attacked anything by ai_category "Strategic Nuclear" AuthoriseStrategic("in kind")
    on attacked anything by geneva "Salted Weapons" AuthoriseSalted("in kind")
    on attacked anything by ai_category "Salted Weapons" AuthoriseSalted("in kind")
  end

  ON TICK +SECONDS(15) DiscoverRivals()
  ON TICK +MINUTES(1) DiscoverRivals()
  // evaluations are staggered per faction (EVAL_OFFSET_SEC is stamped by
  // build.ps1) so nine factions do not all scan the map in the same tick
  ON TICK +SECONDS(EVAL_OFFSET_SEC) StartEvaluations()
END

// ------------------------------------------------ faction entry point --
// (generated by build.ps1 - edit src\WarMotives.txt, not this file)

FOR AI
  SetWarMotives()

  // release the leash on anyone who attacks us
  ON Attacked anything ATTACKER "United States" OnIncidentBy("United States")
  ON Destroyed anything ATTACKER "United States" OnAttackedBy("United States")
  ON Region_Invaded ANY OF ME BY "United States" OnIncursionBy("United States")
  ON Attacked anything ATTACKER "Soviet Union" OnIncidentBy("Soviet Union")
  ON Destroyed anything ATTACKER "Soviet Union" OnAttackedBy("Soviet Union")
  ON Region_Invaded ANY OF ME BY "Soviet Union" OnIncursionBy("Soviet Union")
  ON Attacked anything ATTACKER "NATO" OnIncidentBy("NATO")
  ON Destroyed anything ATTACKER "NATO" OnAttackedBy("NATO")
  ON Region_Invaded ANY OF ME BY "NATO" OnIncursionBy("NATO")
  ON Attacked anything ATTACKER "American Allies" OnIncidentBy("American Allies")
  ON Destroyed anything ATTACKER "American Allies" OnAttackedBy("American Allies")
  ON Region_Invaded ANY OF ME BY "American Allies" OnIncursionBy("American Allies")
  ON Attacked anything ATTACKER "Soviet Allies" OnIncidentBy("Soviet Allies")
  ON Destroyed anything ATTACKER "Soviet Allies" OnAttackedBy("Soviet Allies")
  ON Region_Invaded ANY OF ME BY "Soviet Allies" OnIncursionBy("Soviet Allies")
  ON Attacked anything ATTACKER "China" OnIncidentBy("China")
  ON Destroyed anything ATTACKER "China" OnAttackedBy("China")
  ON Region_Invaded ANY OF ME BY "China" OnIncursionBy("China")
  ON Attacked anything ATTACKER "India" OnIncidentBy("India")
  ON Destroyed anything ATTACKER "India" OnAttackedBy("India")
  ON Region_Invaded ANY OF ME BY "India" OnIncursionBy("India")
  ON Attacked anything ATTACKER "Pakistan" OnIncidentBy("Pakistan")
  ON Destroyed anything ATTACKER "Pakistan" OnAttackedBy("Pakistan")
  ON Region_Invaded ANY OF ME BY "Pakistan" OnIncursionBy("Pakistan")
  ON Attacked anything ATTACKER "Neutral" OnIncidentBy("Neutral")
  ON Destroyed anything ATTACKER "Neutral" OnAttackedBy("Neutral")
  ON Region_Invaded ANY OF ME BY "Neutral" OnIncursionBy("Neutral")

FOR BOTH

END
